urdu transliteration: Aaja asghar ki jaga, meri sakina soja
english translation text: Come and take Asghar's place, oh my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration: Jaagti maa ne kahaa, meri sakina soja hai
english translation text: The wakeful mother said, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
Jo tujhe khauff hai shayed me use kam kardu
aaja aankhon pe tere naade ali kam kardu
door kyun behti hai aa meri sakina soja hai
english translation text:
If there is something frightening you, perhaps I can ease it.
Come, let me recite Nad-e-Ali over your eyes.
Why do you sit so far away? Come, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
chaaar barso me na zehmat di kabhi tune mujhe
apni khidmat ka mujhe aaj to mauka dede
hai mere dil ki sadaa, meri sakina soja
english translation text:
In four years, you never once troubled me.
At least today, give me the chance to serve you.
This is the call of my heart, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
Saabiro ka yeh karina toh, nahin hai bibi
yeh hai pardes madina to, nahin hai bibi
kar ke bas shukr khuda, meri sakina soja
english translation text:
This is not the way of the patient ones, dear daughter.
This is exile, not Madina, dear daughter.
Simply thank Allah and rest, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
Is tarha soyi takallum woh hazina bibi
maa uthathi rahi uthi na sakina bibi
phir na bano ne kahaa, meri sakina soja
english translation text:
In this way, O Takallum, that precious treasure slept.
Her mother kept trying to wake her, but Sakina did not rise.
Then Banu said, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
Baap kai seenay pai aadat hain tujhay sonay ki
Meri goudi teray qaabil ko nahi hain phir bhi
Aye mere dil ki sada meri Sakina soja
english translation text:
You are accustomed to sleeping upon your father's chest.
My lap is not worthy of you, yet still...
O cry of my heart, my Sakina, go to sleep.

urdu transliteration:
Mujhse dekha nahi jaata ye tera dard-e-jigar
Ye batate hue achha to nahi lagta magar
Ab na ayenge chachaa meri Sakina soja
english translation text:
I cannot bear to see the pain within your heart.
It pains me to tell you this, but...
Your uncle Abbas will not be coming back, my Sakina, go to sleep.
